plans.basis: 雏鸡 · 不死 · 商人（该职业擅长赚钱，但不擅长战斗）· 普通 · 远程 600；描述：「飞行单位。能升级为两种不同的形态。」特性「美味」：死亡后，获得其最大生命值1%的积分（死亡时掉落积分，fx 金币）；up：公鸡、火鸡。不死基调：空眼窝魂火、秃骨翅、肚皮缝线（从餐桌上爬回来的鸡）。
plans.body: 飞行（parts-beast B.fly，head 'bird'，crest 'tuft' 改成三根呆毛，tail 'none'，legs 0 收腿）
plans.build: 孩童档飞禽：约 14 格高 × 14 格宽，头身比约 1:1（hr 4 的大圆头压在 rx 5 / ry 4.5 的圆球身体上），短喙（beak 2），小短翅（span 5、chord 2），细短腿；alt 6 贴地低飞。全组最小，普通品质细节少。同线三只轮廓完全不同：雏鸡圆球大头、公鸡竖高挺胸、火鸡横宽加扇尾。
silhouette: 头顶三根翘起的呆毛（轮廓；全线同一位置：公鸡长成鸡冠、火鸡长成肉瘤）
一侧翅膀是秃骨翅：只剩三根细骨加零星绒毛，扑翼时像爪子一样伸出轮廓（轮廓，不死标志）
脖子上红绳挂一枚方孔铜钱，垂到胸前下方晃荡（轮廓，商人标志，全线保留）
肚皮一道厨房麻绳十字缝线；一只眼是空眼窝里一点金色魂火（内部细节）
plans.weapon: 无武器：用喙和嗉囊里的骨米
plans.attackType: 吐（远程）：后仰鼓嗉 1 帧，然后前伸张喙吐出一粒白色骨米弹（2×1 格，淡金拖尾），走轻抛物线
plans.idlePersonality: 歪头眨眼：左右歪头 1 格，魂火眼闪一下；偶尔低头啄一下胸前的铜钱，铜钱晃荡
plans.gait: 扑腾跳飞：不落地，身体一上一下弹跳（离地 6→3→6），短翅高频猛扑；每次沉到最低点掉 1 片绒毛，不扬尘
plans.deathStyle: 爆裂：中弹后先膨成一团，再「噗」地炸成绒毛（小块碎片加羽毛粒子慢慢飘落）；铜钱和 5–6 枚金币弹出，落地弹跳（美味：掉积分）；魂火眼最后熄灭
plans.mainColors: 主材质 灰黄尸绒（褪色蛋黄，灰度高）[勾线 #2a2a22, 暗 #6e6c56, 基 #b4b08c, 亮 #e2dfc2]；骨翅 bone；喙和脚 暗橙 [#3a1a08, #8a4a1a, #c8782a, #eaa848]；红绳 crimson；铜钱 gold。灰度比邪眼王的鲜病黄高得多，两者分得开
plans.element: 美味 · 金币（FXI.coin：21 白 → 5 奶油 → 14 金 → 61 暗沙 → 20 深木）
plans.skillDepicted: 表现「美味」生效：把「掉积分」做成「下金蛋」。雏鸡下出一颗金蛋，蛋在敌人头上碎开，洒成一片积分金币
plans.skillFx: 蓄力 1.4 s：落到最低处蹲窝，全身绒毛炸起（轮廓每边胀 1 格），身下金色光点定点汇聚成蛋形；魂火眼 1→2 档，coin 轮廓光 2 档。施放 0.5 s：身体一弹，屁股下蹦出一颗金蛋（4×5 格，白芯加金），被喙挑飞成抛物线弹道；震屏 2 格，天空闪白。命中：金蛋在假人头顶「啵」地裂成两半，喷出铜钱（20 颗金币粒子上抛，落地弹两次后走完色阶），配小冲击环和十字星芒；假人闪白小摇（商人伤害不高），震屏 1 格。收招 0.7 s：绒毛落回，低头啄铜钱
plans.sound: 细碎的啾啾声加喙碰铜钱的叮当声；标志：下蛋时「啵」的一声，接着金币哗啦滚一地；重量 0.15

plans.basis: 公鸡 · 不死 · 先锋（该职业擅长防御）· 优质 · 近战 256；描述：「飞行单位。近战重装单位。可以适应为塞拉芬。」特性「偏转」：受到的远程单位伤害减少15%（fx 守护）；由雏鸡升级。沿用雏鸡的识别特征：呆毛、铜钱、魂火眼。
plans.body: 飞行（B.fly，head 'bird'，crest 'comb' 鸡冠加肉垂，镰尾自己画，legs 1 垂腿）
plans.build: 挺胸重装飞禽：约 28 格高（含冠和镰尾）× 20 格宽。身体竖起（pitch −2，胸在前上、尾在后上），胸甲前凸 2 格；长腿常垂（legs 1），露出钢爪距；翼展 12，羽片就是甲片；alt 8 低空悬停。和雏鸡的圆球、火鸡的横宽拉开：竖高、挺胸、长腿
silhouette: 大锯齿鸡冠：由雏鸡的三根呆毛长成，5 个齿，比头高 4 格；下面垂着肉垂（轮廓）
镰刀状长尾羽：3 根向后上方高高拱起，超过头顶（轮廓）
两只脚后各一根前弯的长钢爪距（4 格，伸出脚的轮廓，是攻击武器）（轮廓）
雏鸡那枚铜钱长成圆形铜钱护心镜（方孔、铆边）；翅膀外层是鳞片状钢羽甲；空眼窝里是钢白色魂火
plans.weapon: 腿上一对钢爪距（前弯镰形，铁身加钢刃高光）；钢羽甲翼兼作盾
plans.attackType: 踢（近战）：振翅后仰蓄势 1 帧 → 身体前冲 5 格、双腿前蹬，爪距划出两道向下的弧形拖影（fx.slash）→ 退回悬停
plans.idlePersonality: 挺胸打鸣：每个循环仰头张喙一次，鸡冠和肉垂甩动，胸前铜钱护心镜反光一闪
plans.gait: 低空重扑翼：翅膀大开大合，身体起伏 2 格；双腿垂着前后摆，每次下沉时爪距掠过地面，带起 1–2 粒尘
plans.deathStyle: 坠落：中弹后翅膀垂落（wing 6），从空中直直摔到地上（lie 1 → 2）；撞地时震屏并扬尘，侧翻后爪距朝天，2–3 片钢羽甲弹开散落；最后魂火熄灭、化灰
plans.mainColors: 主材质 钢羽甲 steel [#1b1e2a, #394055, #65708a, #a2acc2]；身体 灰白尸羽 pale [8,59,60,17]；鸡冠和肉垂 腐暗红 crimson；爪距 iron；护心镜 gold
plans.element: 偏转 · 钢羽银白（FXI.steel：21 白 → 31 → 30 → 29 → 28）
plans.skillDepicted: 表现「偏转」：远程攻击打在身上被钢羽甲弹开。敌方三支箭射来，被合拢的翅膀盾挡住，再反弹回去
plans.skillFx: 蓄力 1.4 s：落低，两翼向前合拢，在胸前挡成一面羽甲盾；钢羽从翼根到翼尖逐片亮银（半圆 fx.dome 按角度逐点亮起），鸡冠竖起，steel 轮廓光 2 档。施放 0.5 s：三支敌箭（enemy 色阶）依次射来，每支撞盾时那一格变白，溅出 8 颗 steel 火花，响一声「铛」；第三支之后双翼猛地张开（wing 5），把箭反弹回去；震屏 2 格，天空闪白。命中：弹回的三支箭依次钉进假人脚前的地面；假人闪白大摇、击退 1 格，出现钢色冲击环，震屏 1 格。收招：抖一抖翅膀收回，打半声鸣
plans.sound: 钢羽片互相刮擦的沙沙金属声，加一声嘹亮沙哑的「喔—」；标志：箭撞钢羽清脆的一声「铛！」；重量 0.5

plans.basis: 火鸡 · 不死 · 商人（擅长赚钱，不擅长战斗）· 优质 · 远程 640；描述：「飞行单位。远程伤害单位。能转换成近战防御形态的恶魔鱼」。特性「美味」：死亡后获得最大生命值1%的积分（fx 金币）；由雏鸡升级。沿用雏鸡的呆毛位置、铜钱、缝线、魂火眼。
plans.body: 飞行（B.fly，head 'bird'，tail 'fan' 放大成开屏扇尾，肉瘤 snood 自己画，legs 1 垂腿）
plans.build: 横宽圆桶飞禽：身体是 20 格宽 × 12 格高的大椭圆（rx 8, ry 6），细长颈加小头（hr 2.5）；背后竖着一面直径约 18 格的开屏扇尾，整体高约 28 格；短翅（span 9）；alt 7 低空滑翔。和公鸡拉开：横宽、头小，面积最大的是扇尾
silhouette: 背后开屏扇尾：12 根只剩骨质羽轴的秃尾羽，末端挂着破羽片，每根羽尖有一颗铜色眼斑（轮廓：身后一面大半圆锯齿扇）
喙上垂下长长的红肉瘤（snood，从雏鸡呆毛的位置长出来，垂过喙 3 格，会甩），喉下还有肉垂（轮廓）
两条腿套着白色纸花腿套（烤火鸡腿上那种装饰纸花，伸出腿的轮廓 2 格）（轮廓）
脖子上挂一整串红绳方孔铜钱（雏鸡的一枚变成一串 5 枚）；肚皮十字麻绳缝线更粗，还插着一根木签；空眼窝里是铜橙色魂火
plans.weapon: 扇尾骨羽（尾羽本身就是弹药）
plans.attackType: 射（远程抛射）：扇尾向前一甩，一根骨羽从背后越过头顶，沿抛物线射出（2×4 格白骨羽加铜尖），落点插进地里
plans.idlePersonality: 咯咯抖屏：每个循环扇尾猛地抖开再收起一次（羽轴咔啦啦响），同时甩头，肉瘤左右甩
plans.gait: 滑翔：翅膀平展，扑一下滑两拍；身体左右摇摆 1 格（显得肥）；扇尾半收，身下拖 1 颗铜色粒子
plans.deathStyle: 仰翻：坠地后翻成肚皮朝天的「烤火鸡摆盘」姿势，两条套着纸花的腿直直朝天；铜钱串断开，6–8 枚铜币弹出滚开（美味）；最后自上而下消散，魂光上升
plans.mainColors: 主材质 烟熏乌铜羽 [勾线 #140f0c, 暗 #2e2420, 基 #4e3c30, 亮 #7a5c40]，羽缘高光铜色 #c87a3a；骨羽轴 bone；肉瘤和肉垂 腐红 [#3a0a14, #7a1a2a, #b83a44, #e0707a]；纸花腿套 white；铜钱 铜色。比 Brute 的锈红褐更暗、更冷，两者分得开
plans.element: 美味 · 烤铜（fxRamp 自建：21 白 → #ffd8b0 淡杏 → #e8904a 铜橙 → #a0501e 赤铜 → #4a200c 焦褐），和雏鸡的金币色阶拉开
plans.skillDepicted: 表现「美味」：把「打它就掉钱」做成开屏撒铜钱。扇尾每根羽尖亮成铜币，齐射出去，落地变成一地铜币
plans.skillFx: 蓄力 1.4 s：扇尾完全展开（比待机大 2 格），12 个羽尖眼斑从下往上逐根点亮（铜橙 → 淡杏）；肉瘤充血变长；轮廓光 2 档沿扇尾外沿。施放 0.5 s：「咕噜」一声猛甩头，扇尾一震，5 根铜尖骨羽成扇形同时射出（扇面 30°，抛物线）；扇尾顶端闪枪口光；震屏 2 格，天空闪白。命中：5 根骨羽在假人周围插成一排，每根「啪」地炸成一枚旋转铜币（2 帧翻面），弹起再落地；出现铜色冲击环，假人闪白大摇，震屏 1 格。收招：扇尾慢慢合拢，羽尖逐根熄灭
plans.sound: 喉咙里的咕噜噜 gobble 声，加骨羽轴摩擦的咔啦啦；标志：扇形齐射的「嗖嗖嗖」，接着铜币落地的钝铜音；重量 0.45

plans.basis: 步卒 · 不死 · 先锋（擅长防御）· 普通 · 近战 240；描述：「敌人死亡时积攒层数。层数越多最终升级形态越强。」特性「初级渔夫」：附近小范围敌人死亡时获得2.5%法力值，法力值满后或经历5场战斗后升级为赤十字（fx 成长）；up：赤十字。设定：捕魂的溺亡渔夫。
plans.body: 人形（parts.rig standard 改瘦，hunch 1；斗笠、龟壳盾、鱼篓、钩竿要自己画，标「候选部件」）
plans.build: 标准偏瘦档：约 24 格高（含斗笠尖），6 头身，肩窄（sw 3）、腿细，微驼（hunch 1），像常年蹲在河边；斗笠把头部轮廓撑成 11 格宽的扁锥。和守夜人拉开：守夜人是挺直的中年人，戴宽檐平顶帽，持灯盾和长戟直刺；步卒佝着背，戴尖锥斗笠，用龟壳盾和钩竿钩拉
silhouette: 尖锥竹斗笠：帽尖高出头 3 格、左右各伸出 3 格，帽檐阴影里只露出两点青色魂火眼（轮廓；全线保留：赤十字的斗笠系上红带，炎帝的变成火冠）
长钩竿：一根比身高还长的竹竿，顶端弯出一只铁鱼钩（钩尖高出斗笠 4 格），平时斜扛（轮廓）
后臂挎一面龟壳盾：椭圆形、六角甲纹，伸出身后 3 格（轮廓）
腰间挂竹鱼篓，篓口露出一截发光的魂鱼尾巴；身披稻草蓑衣，下摆一圈草穗；灰青尸肤，手指细长
plans.weapon: 钩竿（竹竿加铁鱼钩，钩上系一截鱼线和白色浮漂）+ 龟壳盾（后手）
plans.attackType: 钩拉（双手持竿）：盾收在身侧，竿前探 1 帧，钩尖越过假人后猛地回拽（拖影弧从前往后画），钩中那一下出火花
plans.idlePersonality: 看浮漂：钩竿斜伸在前，竿尖挂的浮漂一点一点上下，他歪头盯着看；每个循环轻轻提一次竿
plans.gait: 拄竿拖步：钩竿当拐杖，一步一点地；脚步拖沓，蓑衣草穗反向摆；接触帧扬 1 颗尘，竿头点地再扬 1 颗
plans.deathStyle: 前扑：踉跄后脸朝下扑倒，斗笠飞出滚两圈，龟壳盾翻倒压在背上；鱼篓里游出 2 条魂鱼，绕一圈后上升消散（魂光）
plans.mainColors: 主材质 稻草蓑衣 [勾线 #221a0c, 暗 #4e3e1e, 基 #7e6a38, 亮 #aa965a]；斗笠 竹黄 sand；灰青尸肤 pale [8,59,60,17]；龟壳 暗绿褐 [#141a0c, #2e3a1a, #4e5a2a, #7a8446]；鱼钩 iron
plans.element: 渔魂 · 冷魂青（FXI.soul：22 青 → 23 蓝 → 24 紫 → 25 深紫 → 3 夜）。升级线的元素逐级变热：冷魂 → 赤 → 帝焰
plans.skillDepicted: 表现「初级渔夫」：身边的敌人一死，他就把魂「钓」走。抛竿钩住假人，钓出一条魂鱼收进鱼篓，攒一层
plans.skillFx: 蓄力 1.4 s：甩竿抛线（竿先后引再前甩），鱼线（fx.link 虚线）落到假人头上，浮漂在假人头顶上下点三次；魂青光点从假人身上螺旋汇聚到浮漂；斗笠下的魂火眼 1→2 档。施放 0.5 s：猛地扬竿（竿竖起，定格 1 帧），一条 5 格长的魂鱼被从假人身上拽出，沿抛物线甩回来；天空闪白，震屏 2 格。命中：魂鱼钻进腰间鱼篓，鱼篓爆亮，从鱼篓处扩出冲击环，脚下 12 颗魂光向上飘（成长）；全身轮廓光闪 1 帧 3 档，震屏 1 格；假人闪白小摇。收招：鱼篓里的鱼尾摆一摆，竿收回斜扛
plans.sound: 湿蓑衣的沙沙声加竹竿轻敲；标志：扬竿时鱼线绷紧的「嗖—啪」，接着魂鱼入篓的一声空灵水泡「咕嘟」；重量 0.4

silhouette: 还是那顶尖锥斗笠，檐上交叉系了两条朱红长布带，带尾在身后飘 5 格（轮廓）

plans.basis: 神石 · 不死 · 先锋（擅长防御）· 史诗 · 远程 0；描述：「独特单位。无法移动或攻击，但是能反弹受到的伤害。在两波后进化为九头蛇，或者在被击碎后提前孵化为稍弱的形态。」特性「孵化」：2场战斗后，如果存活，就能够进化成巨人战神（fx 成长）；「蓝铜矿外壳」：反弹自身最大生命值0.4%的伤害（fx 反伤）；「蛋炸」：死亡时，对小范围敌人造成自身最大生命值4%的技能伤害（fx 亡语）。三条特性分给三个状态：反伤做攻击，孵化做技能，蛋炸做死亡。

壳面蜿蜒着孔雀石绿纹路；壳上有 2–3 根细小晶刺，反伤时伸出

built.feedback: 1）这三个角色的模块、design.md 和 review-1 目录之前就有（上一次运行留下的），但任务里没有带验收意见，所以我在原文件上按 standard.md 第 10 节自查后返修，没有从零重做；design.md 里补了「第 4 轮」修改记录。2）frames.mjs 的 --contact 模式会把 --scale 后面的数值当成 sprite.json 文件名去读，直接报 ENOENT，得去掉 --scale 才能出对比表（脚本第 51–52 行过滤参数时只去掉了以 -- 开头的项）。3）fly 骨架如果配长垂腿，按默认的 alt 算，脚会贴着地面线，读起来像站着；parts-beast.md 第六节可以提醒一句：垂腿的飞禽要让脚尖离地 2–4 格，并画地面影子。4）小体型（身体 ry ≤ 5）用 B.mats 的 main 默认 band 2 时，身体会整块发暗，需要手动改成 band 1；parts-beast.md 可以补这条说明。

chars.summary: 步卒：一个佝背的溺亡渔夫（standard 改瘦，hunch 1，24×31）。尖锥竹斗笠，檐下只露青色魂火眼；比身高还长的竹钩竿，挂着鱼线和红白浮漂；后臂挎六角纹龟壳，稻草蓑衣下摆一圈草穗，腰间竹鱼篓露出发光的魂鱼尾。攻击是双手钩拉：先前探，钩尖越过假人，再猛地回拽，出拖影和火花。技能表现「初级渔夫」：抛竿，浮漂落到假人头顶点三下，魂青光点螺旋汇聚过去；扬竿定格时拽出一条魂鱼，甩进鱼篓，鱼篓爆亮，出冲击环，12 颗魂光往上飘，震屏 2 格加天空闪白。待机是看浮漂、提一次竿；移动是拄竿拖步；死亡是前扑，斗笠往身后滚两圈，两条魂鱼游出后消散。本轮修了死亡时篓口鱼尾一直亮着的问题（发光体要熄灭）。shoot 和 compare 都是退出码 0，最近的是巨魔（0.616）；gaitEvery2 前 4 个编号各不相同。音色：body flesh、how topple、pal water、style spiral、w 0.4。

赤十字：步卒长壮后的样子（heroic，26×36）。还是那顶尖锥斗笠，加了朱红帽带，两条带尾往身后飘；龟壳挪到背上当背甲，往后隆起 4 格，壳面一个过壳心的血十字；胸前朱红带交叉成 X，暗朱红短罩衣下露出稻草裙；后肩搭一卷暗灰渔网，腰间鱼篓挂一串赤魂鱼；钩镰长刀。攻击是 120° 横扫，钩背顺势回带。技能表现「商业渔夫」：把网举过头顶转圈，背壳十字逐档变亮；扇形撒网罩住假人（血朱描边、下陷 1 格），一网拽出三条赤魂鱼飞回背壳，最后十字爆白出冲击环。待机磨钩，移动是行军大步，死亡是跪倒后化灰（ash），红布带最后落下。本轮按放大图返修：去掉盖住胸口的稻草披肩，露出罩衣和 X 带；罩衣和稻草裙提高，长腿露出 5 格；龟壳往背后挪，十字改成过壳心；渔网从米白（像第二张脸）改成暗灰；待机钩镰前移、加长，背钩不再戳帽檐和鼻子，磨刀白光落到刃上；修了熄灭档被映射成最亮白十字的问题，加了暗血熄灭档。shoot 和 compare 都是退出码 0，最近的是钢铁军阀（0.695），和同批互查也不撞；--prev 列出的消失区域都是有意改的。音色：flesh、dissolve、blood、summon、w 0.6。

炎帝：这条升级线的终点（tall 改，28×41，传说品质）。暗金鳞片拼的尖锥火冠，檐上一圈金焰，冠顶一簇 4 格冠焰；龟壳成了焰壳，壳脊一排火，下面垂焦黑破边长披风；暗金鳞甲长袍及地，胸前金边红绶带交叉；帝焰巨钩镰（钢刃、钢背钩、刃口金焰），身边绕着游三条金焰火鱼。攻击是 130° 上挑，刃口甩出 3 颗火星。技能表现「精英渔夫」：三条火鱼和帝焰粒子螺旋收进胸口，每吞一条冠焰长 1 格、轮廓光升一档；全身爆燃白闪，头顶一道金焰光柱冲天；钩镰插地推出金焰地浪，把假人点燃（dummyFx tint fire），外爆 30 颗，出大冲击环。帝焰色阶用 fxRamp 自建（21→51→14→46→45）。待机抚鱼，移动是帝王缓步、每步留金焰余烬，死亡是站着燃尽（ash），钩镰最后「当」地倒下。本轮返修：火鱼改成 6×3 的鱼形，加焦红勾线和鱼眼，不再读成火苗；背钩改成钢，不再和金柄连成一道 Z；脸上的帽檐阴影从 3 行减到 2 行；死亡时檐焰和壳脊火跟魂火眼一起熄灭。shoot 和 compare 都是退出码 0，最近的是钢铁军阀（0.721），同批最近的是大法师（0.691）。音色：armor、dissolve、fire、fire、w 0.8。

chars.summary: The Ogre is an undead cook with an inverted-triangle stocky build (37×29). It wears a whole bear-head hood (two round ears with a 3-cell gap, a snout sticking forward, a black nose), carries a big iron pot tied to its back with steam coming off it, and holds a 6×5 frying pan in its front hand. The pan was redrawn as a light rim, dark base and a burnt patch on a 4-cell handle, because before it read as an iron ball. Idle (sneaking a bite of meat), walk (splay-footed waddle), attack (backhand pan slap) and Hardening (three pan thumps on the chest, rock shell, ground crack) all work. The death pose was redone: it now lies on its back on the tipped-over pot with one knee up, broth spilling out, the hood slid off and the pan landing with a clang. shoot, compare and frames all pass. Closest match is 奴隶主 at idle IoU 0.631. The design card in design.md is updated.

The BrownBear is built on the quad beast rig with body length raised to 19 (40×30), close to the ~42-cell length in the brief. It carries the Ogre's pot, now bigger, with the frying pan as its lid and green steam rising. Three rib tips stick out of the shoulder hump, it has the upturned tusks, frost patches, a green soul-fire eye and white claws. The belly ropes now sit in the same part as the torso, and the side stitch was redrawn as a slanted seam with paired ladder stitches. Before, the flank read as a checkered cage. Idle (sniffing), walk (diagonal gait), attack (pounce and claw with three claw marks), Resonance skill (rear up with bubbling pot, green circle, links to allies with outline, rising crosses and a shield dome) and death (lies on its back, pot rolls off, green soup spills) all work. shoot, compare and frames all pass. Closest match is 黄鬃马 at idle IoU 0.639. design.md is updated.

The Commander is an armored giant (32×38) with a small head sunk between the shoulders, a tower shield in front with the frying pan riveted at its centre, and three gold commander bars on the chest (now its own part, so all three show). The cannon is the pot raised behind the shoulders with a longer, lighter steel barrel. The cannon metal no longer takes rim light: before, the barrel turned into an orange outline during the cast. The bear-head shoulder guard now draws after the back arm in a lighter fur shade, so its ears and snout stick out past the shoulder line. The pan on the shield was redrawn with a light rim and dark base. For the walk, stride went up to 4 and the shield lifts 3 cells, so the silhouette shows the feet alternating. Idle (checking the cannon), attack (shield slam into the ground, crack, target slowed), Cannon Shock skill (kneel, fuse burns down, boom and recoil, shell arcs in, explosion with stun and slow) and death (falls apart with the parts kit) all work. shoot, compare and frames all pass. Closest match is 钢铁军阀 at idle IoU 0.629 but colour 0.961, only 0.07 under the IoU cutoff. The cannon, tower shield and bear-head shoulder guard outline are what separate it. design.md is updated.

built.feedback: 1) The quad rig's pitch 6 ('人立') only raises the chest by 6 cells and never turns the body upright. The BrownBear brief's 'about 44 cells tall when rearing' can't be reached with it; the design card says so. 2) When parts.rig lies down (rot 90°), a stocky body (leg 7, lw 4) gets two straight overlapping legs that merge into a block. There is no way to bend the legs or spread the step when lying, so the Ogre's legs had to be drawn by hand in the FREE frame. A 'lying leg pose' option in the library would help. 3) With the death.start('parts') kit, the last two DEATH columns in frames.mjs --contact show the kneeling sprite from before the collapse. The flying fragments only appear in the screenshots, which reviewers can easily misread as 'no down pose'. 4) frames.mjs reports MOVE distinct 20 for every character: mx is counted into the frame, which contradicts audit's 4 and is confusing. Only gaitEvery2 is reliable. 5) When a hand-drawn detail (the ropes around the belly) sits in its own part over a large body area, the boundary lines turn the area into a grid. The README could say plainly: 'decorations that sit on a body surface go in the same part as that body'.

chars.summary: 水战士（/Users/yseer/Code/midnight-cabinet/pcd/chars/WaterWarrior.js）：溺尸刺客，常驻伏低，待机约 23 格高。分配写的是 crouch 2，但 rig 每档 crouch 压低 1 格，按 2 算待机会到 24 格，所以取 crouch 3 贴近「伏低 22 格」，design.md 里写明了。身体是 rig slim 加部件库的腿、躯干、手臂、头、头发，湿长发、半透明锯齿背鳍、反握鱼颌骨短刃（贴前臂伸出肘外）是自己画的。攻击：前冲 5 格，反握双刃交叉连斩两道水碧弧。技能「伏击」：脚下渗水，按行沉进水面，只剩头发漂转一圈，咕咚一声没入并出两圈涟漪；施放时假人脚下冲起水柱，他从假人身后跃出，剪刀合斩在假人身上交成 X，24 颗带重力的水花加大冲击环。待机个性甩水，腮裂一张一合；步态是伏身潜行小跑，脚印留水渍；死亡是跪倒后融化成水滩（死亡套件 melt），短刃留在水里，最后蒸发成水碧粒子。本轮修了湿发：原来飘直时两绺叠成一块 3 行厚的横板，现在是三绺长短不一、往后拖的那段 1 格细、波浪错相，读得出是海草发。shoot 0；compare 0，最近的是鹰喙弓手（待机剪影重合度 0.597）；和同批当前产出两两比也没撞脸。移动的 gaitEvery2 前 4 个各不相同。音效 SFX 是 flesh / collapse / water / shadow / 0.35，step、swing×2、hit×2、impact×2、fall 都落在对应帧上。

不朽蓝魔（/Users/yseer/Code/midnight-cabinet/pcd/chars/ImmortalBlueDemon.js）：水战士魔化后的样子，瘦高踮脚、腰极细，含角约 31 格。身体是 rig slim 加 parts.horns 后掠角，飘鬃、魔尾、背鳍、踮脚爪足、鱼骨月牙弯刃是自己画的。和水战士的对应：湿发变成蓝黑长鬃，半透明背鳍变成实心带骨刺的暗蓝鳍，反握短刃变成正握月牙刃，腮裂变成发光腮纹。攻击：踮脚前突 6 格，双刃连刺两次（第二刺刃口闪白），然后后跳回原位。技能「伏击」：蓄力时身体从外沿往里逐像素化成暗影剪影，最后只剩眼光和刃口亮点，脚下翻暗影烟；施放时原位残影炸散，三个残影依次逼近假人，假人头顶撕开暗影裂口；命中时他头下脚上落下，双月刃竖直插进假人，出十字星芒、30 颗暗影外爆、大冲击环，假人下陷 1 格；收招翻身落地，化影解除。待机个性是转刃；步态是贴地滑步，每 4 帧留一个暗影残影。本轮改了四处：长鬃加长到 8 格、根部 6 行厚、往后上方飘，末端换成暗影色化烟；背鳍改成 3 片实心鳍，第一片尖端高出肩线约 4 格；sw 从 4 改成分配写的 3；死亡加了单膝跪的一拍（tiptoeLegs 补了跪姿），现在是跪倒、化影、月刃落地、从脚往上化烟。shoot 0；compare 0，最近的是守夜人（待机剪影重合度 0.601）；和同批两两比也没撞脸。gaitEvery2 前 4 个各不相同。音效 SFX 是 ghost / dissolve / shadow / blade / 0.3。两个角色的 compare --prev（和本轮开工前的版本比）都返回 3，标出的消失区域都是有意改的头发、长鬃、背鳍，蓝魔还有 sw 变窄带来的前沿，已记在各自 shots/compare-prev.txt 和 design.md 的自检记录里。

built.feedback: 1）frames.mjs 的 --contact 模式不能用 --scale：文件列表只滤掉以 -- 开头的参数，--scale 后面的数值（如 5）会被当成 sprite.json 路径去读，直接报错。2）逐帧放大图一个状态一整条（待机 29 帧、7000 多像素宽），看图时会被缩小到看不清，只好用 sips 裁出几帧来看；如果 frames.mjs 能按帧号范围出图（比如 --frames 3-9）会方便很多。3）scratchpad 是几个制作代理共用的，我最早建的 r0 目录被别人删掉了，重跑了一遍；建议在说明里写一句「临时目录要带自己的角色名前缀」。4）分配里有几处数值和目标对不上：水战士「常驻 crouch 2」按 rig 算高 24 格，达不到「伏低 22 格」；蓝魔「约 30 格高（含角）」和「头身比 1:7」（头高 7 格就要 49 格高）也互相矛盾。本轮按高度目标取值，并在 design.md 里写明了原因。

chars.summary: 冰雪法师（不死 · 法师 · 稀有 · 远程）：瘦高头重的骷髅冰法师，待机约 26×32 格。这一轮在上一版基础上返修：毛领原来盖到腰，像一团白棉球，脸只剩 3 列，现在改成从肩上竖起的高领（后沿高出肩线 4 行，盖住半个后脑；下沿只到肩线下 3 行，胸口露出冰蓝长袍）；骷髅头从 5×6 放大到 6×7；5 根冰锥里有两根加长，从毛领后面伸出来；受击和冻住时三叉杖的叉头原来压在脸上，现在让开。攻击是三叉杖依次射出 3 根冰针（部落战争）。技能是冰焰狂怒（超级鼓舞）：身后炸开锯齿冰焰光环，接 9 根加速冰针，最后一根冻住假人，同时冒十字冰晶回血。死亡是冻裂：从脚往上结冰，再碎成冰块（chunks），三叉杖断成两截。自检：shoot 退出码 0；compare 退出码 0，最接近奴隶主，待机 IoU 0.668；移动 gaitEvery2 前 4 帧为 0,2,4,6；compare --prev review-1 退出码 0；和大法师互查 IoU 0.534。产出：pcd/chars/IceAndSnowMage.js、pcd/batch-01/IceAndSnowMage/design.md、pcd/batch-01/IceAndSnowMage/shots。

大法师（不死 · 法师 · 神话 · 远程）：冰雪法师升级后的悬浮骷髅法王，待机约 26×35 格。沿用冰雪法师的毛领、骷髅脸和三叉杖，冰棱冠长成 7 根冰锥的悬浮冰冕，三颗冰晶绕身公转，背后一件银白钟形披风。这一轮返修：①披风原来拖到地面，看不出悬空，现在底边收到和袍尖齐平，全身离地 4 格，身下只有影子（分配里写的是「及地」，和「悬空 4 格」冲突，design.md 里写明了理由）；②骷髅头跟冰雪法师一起改成 6×7；③技能里原来三道光束从同一点出发、糊成一条，现在两个回声剪影后低前高各错开 3 格，三束平行、间隔约 6 格；回声剪影原来只完整显示 1 帧，现在保持到命中后才抖动消散。攻击是三颗环绕冰晶沿弧线追踪飞向假人，每颗命中炸一圈回声环。死亡是空袍坠地。自检：shoot 退出码 0；compare 退出码 0，最接近钢铁军阀，待机 IoU 0.639；compare --prev review-1 退出码 3，消失的只有 y −4..0 的旧披风下摆，是有意改的。产出：pcd/chars/Archmage.js、pcd/batch-01/Archmage/design.md、pcd/batch-01/Archmage/shots。

chars.summary: Rebuilt the drawing from scratch (the earlier auto-faceted egg came out as a noisy blob with an eye you couldn't read). The egg is now a hand-toned faceted map, 16×21: five large facets with light ridges between them, three angled corners on the upper left, and a winding malachite vein. A 4×2 eye window sits where the top crack opens, with a clearly visible soul-fire eye (ring, iris, pupil; it blinks and looks around). Three crystal spikes on the front side. The nest is a hand-drawn ring of ash-rock rubble (the same stone the Giant is made of), with a broken femur, a half-buried skull and a broken bone sticking up out of the outline behind. Attack (reflect): the enemy shot hits the shell, the struck facet flashes white, the spikes extend and an azurite spike fires back. Skill (hatch): the heartbeat bulges get faster (one thump sound per beat), the shell darkens one step and glowing cracks spread down from the top, the cap flies off, the eye opens fully, a light pillar shoots up, and the cap lands on the dummy and shatters. On recover a new crystal facet forms over the gap. Move: rocks and hops (back tilt, stretch, forward tilt, airborne), 2 cells per hop. Death: cracks go white-hot, one white frame, burst kit breaks the egg, only the nest stays, the dead eye rolls out. shoot 0 / compare 0 (closest: Brute 0.644); gaitEvery2 first four frames all different. Design doc in batch-01/Stone/design.md.

Rebuilt the drawing. In the earlier version the helm and pauldrons stacked into one blue column, the obelisk read as a kite shield and the cores were hidden. Rig is giant, thickened: head 7, headX 4, neck 2, limb 2.0, lw 6, hunch 3. Candidate parts written in the module: shell helm (drawn in the same part as the stone head, eye hole dark with only the soul-fire eye showing, chin visible under the rim); small front pauldron and large back pauldron with the jagged crest on the rear side; rock torso (barrel chest, no pecs/navel); three cores in a vertical column; shell faulds; 4×4 stone fists. The obelisk maul was changed so the point sits in the bone socket and the wide base is the far, striking end: in idle it stands base-down in front of him (a monument with the handle up), overhead it stands above his head, on the smash it lies flat on the ground and reaches the dummy, and on the move it is dragged behind. Idle: the three cores light top to bottom, then the eye. Skill: maul planted, cores light one by one (one low drum hit each), summoning circle, slam, three 7×8 golem silhouettes (shell shard, eye, fists) rise and charge in three hits. Death: two green seams split him into three pieces that fly up, forward and topple back, seam glow dims after the split, the three cores go out in turn, then chunks. shoot 0 / compare 0 (closest: SteelWarlord 0.579); no collision with any batch-01 sibling. Design doc in batch-01/GiantGodOfWar/design.md.

built.feedback: 1) In frames.mjs --contact mode, the value after --scale is treated as a filename (the filter only drops arguments that start with --), so the command fails with ENOENT '6'. Only the default scale works. 2) parts.torso 'bare' always draws pecs, abs and a navel, with no switch to turn them off; stone or construct creatures have to draw their own torso. 3) With a small head (7 rows or less), the helm and pauldrons are separate parts, so the face gets pressed to outline color almost entirely. The workaround was to draw the head and helm in the same part and darken the eye-hole pixels by hand. It may be worth documenting this in the README's "small head" section. 4) This environment's shell is zsh, so an unquoted $var does not split into multiple paths; compare.mjs got a single argument and printed 'fewer than two characters'. Use bash -c or an array to pass the file list.

chars.summary: The Golem (魔像) is finished in /Users/yseer/Code/midnight-cabinet/pcd/chars/Golem.js, with the design cards in batch-01/Golem/design.md and self-check output in batch-01/Golem/shots. An earlier version of Golem.js was already there (review-1 on disk, not accepted). I kept its effects and state framework and redrew the body. The old outline read as a low mound: the fists touched the ground, the front arm was a thin diagonal stripe, and the head shard looked like an antenna. The new body is a flat-shouldered rounded malachite boulder (12 rows, 14 wide). The two 5x5 stone fists now hang front and back at knee height, 3 cells off the ground, so the outline reads as a Π. The front arm is a thick stone column coming out from under a round shoulder stone. The head is a small 4x4 stone half-sunk into the shoulders with one soul-fire eye; its material is separate so the core's rim light no longer washes over the eye. The blue shard is now 4 wide and angled back into the head, rising 3 cells. The crystal cluster sits in front of the chest core and the back shell moved to mid-back, so together they no longer read as a pair of shoulder pads. The hop gait now moves only during the three airborne frames (8 cells per hop) and turns around on landing, so it no longer slides on the landing frame. The charge particles are denser. Unchanged from the earlier version: the straight punch; the skill (curl into a ball, spin faster and faster, roll into the dummy, bounce back, unfold, clap fists); hurt; and death (fists drop first, the body collapses into a rubble pile with the chunks death kit, the soul core rolls out and goes dark). SFX (stone / collapse / earth / meteor / 0.6) fires step, swing, hit, impact and fall on the matching frames. shoot.mjs exit 0 (audit clean, 12 own colours, idle 24x25). compare.mjs exit 0 against the accepted set (closest: VikingWarrior, idle overlap 0.549), and no match against the 15 other batch-01 characters (closest: Stone, idle overlap 0.656, colour 0.336). frames.mjs gaitEvery2 = 0–9, all different. compare --prev against review-1 flags every standing state (exit 3); all of it is the intended redraw and is recorded in design.md.

built.feedback: 1) frames.mjs --state matches on the English prefix of the state name, so the three skill phases need --state SKILL (the 蓄力/charge part of the name doesn't match). Worth a line in the usage text. 2) compare.mjs can't compare against scattered batch-01/<key>/shots/sprite-lite.json files passed as a list: it switches to pairwise mode and reports fewer than two characters. I had to copy them into <key>/ subfolders first. Worth documenting. 3) The part-boundary rule means a small front part sitting on a tiny head (the shard) turns the head's top row into outline colour. The workaround is to draw the fragment behind the head so the insertion seam falls on the fragment. Consider adding this to the README's 'small head' section.

suggestions: IDLE/MOVE, all frames: the red string is two crimson pixels lying flat right under the lower beak, at (3,-13) and (4,-13). At game scale it reads as a tongue sticking out. Run the string as a 1-pixel diagonal from the back of the neck to the top edge of the coin, or darken it to crimson tone 2, and leave 1 empty row between it and the beak.

Overall size: the idle bounding box is 18×22, larger than the lane's roughly 14×14. The audit minimum height is 16, so aim for 16–18 tall: shrink the head by one step or lower the three tufts by 1 pixel so the chick is clearly smaller than the rooster and turkey.

Silhouette: in the pure-black view, head and body merge into one pear shape, so the 'round ball head + round ball body' build is lost. Pull the body in by 1 pixel on each side where it meets the head, or give the back of the neck a 1-pixel notch, so the black silhouette shows two stacked round shapes.

Coin: the 1-pixel square hole reads as a black dot, and the whole coin looks like an orange ball or an eyeball. Make the hole 2×1 or add a 1-pixel light rim ring on the coin face so it reads more clearly as a square-holed coin.

DEATH: the burst uses the death kit and the final pose is empty, which is correct. Consider making the coins that fall to the ground briefly show a 2-frame coin flip, echoing the flip in the skill's coin burst.
review.note: shoot.mjs exit 0 (audit passed, no palette violations, no sfx issues, 5 own colors). compare.mjs exit 0; closest is 维京战士 (idle IoU 0.484 / cast 0.344 / color 0.343). In-batch compare: 雏鸡–火鸡 0.414/0.368/0.292, 雏鸡–公鸡 0.362/0.315/0.162, 雏鸡–水战士 0.604/0.571/0.308; all below the threshold. sfx: swing and shoot land on the attack release frame f2, hit is on the landing frame at 0.517 s, and the skill's shoot, impact and fall line up with the egg flick, the egg cracking and the coins settling. Three tufts, bone wing, coin and stitches are all present. Idle has the head tilt and the peck at the coin; the move is a hopping flight with fluff dropping; the skill (squat and fluff up, gold dots gather into an egg, egg pops out and is flicked, cracks over the dummy's head and sprays coins) reads clearly; death goes swell → burst into fluff → coins drop → soul fire goes out. Main weaknesses are the silhouette and the tongue-like string; not blocking, so it passes.

suggestions: Belly stitches (IDLE and all standing frames): the 11-pixel stitch line with 3 X marks shows at game scale as a row of tan dots on a black band, which reads like a studded belt or a row of teeth. Drop the black backing line, make each X a clear 3×3 diagonal cross, and leave 2 or more pixels of body color between the X marks.

Body shading: the smoked-bronze body is dark and full of copper scale marks, coin-string outlines and wing boundaries, so the interior is cluttered. Reduce the copper scale marks by another third, and use tone 4 of the smoked-bronze material for the near wing's leading edge so the wing reads as a distinct, lighter shape.

Fan-tail silhouette: in the black silhouette the idle fan shows only as small bumps and reads as a round tuft. Make the short shafts 1 pixel shorter again (3 pixels shorter than the long ones), or give the torn vane on each long shaft 1 more pixel sticking out, so the outer edge shows a clear sawtooth.

SKILL hit (0.3–0.5 s after cast): each bone feather turns into a spinning coin only 3 pixels wide, which reads like a copper sparkle rather than a coin. Make the coin face 4×4 with a 1-pixel hole, flipping between 4 and 1 pixels wide over 2 frames, and let it rest on the ground for 0.2 s before running out its color ramp.
MOVE: with the fan half-folded, the gliding silhouette becomes a generic round bird. Keep the fan at radius 10 or more, spread about 120°, so the fan stays in the outline while moving.
review.note: shoot.mjs exit 0 (audit passed, 10 own colors). compare.mjs exit 0; closest is 钟表匠 (0.652/0.611/0.391). In-batch compare: 火鸡–公鸡 0.612/0.611/0.233, 火鸡–不朽蓝魔 0.608; all below the threshold. sfx: swing and shoot on attack release frame f2; hit when the bone feather lands at 0.567 s; the skill's shoot at the start of cast; impact when the feathers stick in the ground and burst into coins; fall on the landing frame f11. Fan tail (bone shafts + torn vanes + copper eye spots), snood, paper-frill leg covers, coin string and wooden skewer are all in place. The fan shake in idle is readable. The skill (fan opens fully and the eye spots light up one by one → 5 bone feathers fire in a fan-shaped volley → they stick in a row around the dummy and burst into copper coins) works as 美味 (Tasty), throwing coins with a display. The death's 'roast turkey on a plate' pose (belly up, frilled legs pointing at the sky, coins bouncing out) is very characterful. Main weaknesses are the cluttered body interior and the silhouette of the fan edge; not blocking, so it passes.

suggestions: ATTACK, release frame (0.167–0.25 s): the two downward spur slash trails are near-white steel, and they sit exactly over the white-flashed dummy, so they almost vanish. Draw the slashes in front of the dummy at 1–2 pixels from its front edge; on frame 1 use steel tone 2 (31) with a dark edge (28) instead of pure white, or delay the dummy flash by 1 frame.

ATTACK, spurs: the spur is only 3 pixels and shows only as white dots when kicking. On the release frame make the spur blade 1 pixel longer and give the tip a tone-4 highlight so the silhouette clearly shows a curved hook in front of the feet.
ATTACK, follow-through (around 0.42 s): the beak and wattle cover the dummy's left arm. Reduce the forward dash by 1–2 pixels, or pull back 2 pixels from the second frame of the follow-through.

Face: the eye is a steel-white pixel (1f) next to a black pixel (00), set against pale #9aaac8. The white and grey are too close in value, and the black pixel is right against the base of the beak, so the eye barely reads at game scale. Move the eye socket 1 pixel toward the back of the head, away from the beak.

Body (idle): 重装 (heavy armor) mainly shows on the tail and wings; the chest and belly are pale grey feathers. Consider adding 1–2 rows of steel-plate edging on the upper chest, next to the heart-guard mirror, to strengthen the vanguard/heavy-armor read.
Comb: the 5 teeth are only 1 pixel apart and merge into a 3-bump crown in the outlined silhouette. Change teeth 2 and 4 to 1 pixel lower, alternating, or widen the gaps between teeth.

suggestions: MOVE：两个接触帧（MOVE:0 / MOVE:4）的脚位互换只靠色阶来区分（远侧腿 wood 20 / pale 59，近侧腿 19 / 60），纯黑剪影两帧几乎一样。建议接触 A 让蓑衣草穗前摆 1 格、接触 B 后摆 1 格，或者让竿尾点地的 x 在两帧差 1 格，剪影上也能看出换脚。

review.note: 上一轮的阻断问题已经改好：龟壳现在是 8×10 的竖椭圆（x −12..−6，y −18..−7），比披肩外沿多伸出 4 格，画在披肩之后，有脊盾、肋盾、缘盾缝和左上高光；剪影行背后有一个单独的半圆鼓包，能读成盾，看得出是先锋（擅长防御）；扑倒后龟壳翻过来压在背上，是一个圆顶。shoot 退出码 0（audit 无问题，log 无报错，待机 29×31，自有色 8 个）。compare 退出码 0，最接近的是奴隶主（待机 IoU 0.619，配色 0.613）。compare --prev 退出码 0，新增的都在旧龟壳位置，消失的只有 1–2 格，是旧小龟壳的下角。frames：gaitEvery2 为 0,2,4,6；待机个性（提竿）落在 1.67–1.92 s。音效时间点对得上：step 在 f0/f4 接触帧，swing 在 f2 前探帧，hit 在 f3 回拽帧，fall 在 0.967 s 落地。钩拉攻击、钓魂技能（鱼线 + 浮漂 → 拽出魂鱼 → 入篓冲击环）、前扑死亡（斗笠滚回身后、魂鱼游出）都和分配一致。和步卒 → 赤十字 → 炎帝的升级线一致（斗笠、龟壳、钩竿）。已通过，sprite-lite 已复制到 pcd/accepted/FootSoldier/。

suggestions: ATTACK f2-f4 (thrust and follow-through): the 9×9 glaive head is rotated 90° flat and reads as a ladle or bowl with a handle, not a hook glaive. Draw a dedicated horizontal glaive head (edge facing forward, point hooking forward, back hook pointing up), and do not rotate the upright head.

The lane build is heroic with long legs, but the legs only show about 5 cells (y -7..0). With the large shell, ribbons and net roll the upper body looks heavy and the whole figure reads a bit stocky. Raise the coat hem 1-2 more cells, or lengthen the legs by 1-2 cells.

The dark vermilion coat mixes 3-4 reds in scattered patches, and the crossed chest straps (blood) have almost no contrast against it. Merge the coat into larger two-tone blocks, and give the straps a 1-cell highlight line to separate them from the coat.
The static segment from kneel to the ash dissolve (about 0.75 -> 1.4 s) is just around 0.6 s. You could move the ash start 0.1-0.2 s later so the dissolve falls in the standard's 1.6-2.4 s window.
review.note: shoot exit 0 (audit pass, 26×36, 12 own colors); compare exit 0, closest is Steel Warlord (钢铁军阀, idle IoU 0.695, cast IoU 0.657, color 0.405). It carries the hat, turtle shell, creel and hook from FootSoldier, grows 4 cells taller and stands upright. The big red cross on the back shell plus the long glaive read as a warrior with simple defense. Gait: frames 0/4 swap feet with the far leg darker, and passing frames lift a foot. Idle personality (whetting the hook) has the arm reaching up to the blade with a white glint. Skill chain is complete: net ellipse whirls overhead as the cross brightens in steps -> net thrown in a fan -> red mesh covers the dummy with blood outline -> 3 red fish fly back -> cross flashes white with a large ring. Death: kneel with the glaive planted, hat slides off, cross fades to dried blood, head-to-foot ash, ribbons fall last. SFX steps, swing/hit and fall all land on the right frames. All 12 scores are at least 3 and there are no blockers, so it passes. review-1/sprite-lite.json has been copied to accepted/RedCross/.

suggestions: MOVE passing frames 2 and 6 (12 fps index; gait frames 1 and 3): the foot that is lifting is hidden entirely under the robe hem. plans.idlePersonality: 扶锅：锅盔慢慢滑下来盖住眼睛，赶紧用一只手推回去，然后紧张地左右张望、咽一下口水（喉头动一下）；两条短腿偶尔抖一下
plans.gait: 慌张小跑：每秒 8 帧的快碎步（stride 2），身体上下颠 1 格，锅盔一颠一颠（锅柄上下晃），草叉乱点；每步 1 颗尘
plans.deathStyle: 坐倒滚躺：被打得后退两步，一屁股坐到地上（扬尘），再往后一仰，滚成侧躺。锅盔飞起来，扣在地上「铛铛铛」转 3 圈才停，草叉倒在身旁；然后自上而下消散 + 魂光
plans.mainColors: 主材质：土褐粗布外衣 wood [0, 20, 19, 16]（band 2）+ 奶白衬衫袖 bone [8, 7, 6, 17]。灰围裙 stone [0, 8, 9, 10]；铁锅 iron [0, 27, 28, 29]（锅底一片烟黑）；草叉 wood + iron；麻绳 sand；肤 skin + 红脸蛋（blush）；草鞋 sand。全批唯一的土褐粗布，没有任何金属甲和发光体
plans.element: 尘土 · 杂石：dust [6, 7, 10, 9, 8]（碎石、尘团），命中火花用 impact。没有魔法元素（他是平民）
plans.skillDepicted: 没有特性，所以表现「守城」的本能：放下草叉，从地上抱起一块大石头，吃力地举过头顶，朝敌人砸过去（城头投石）
plans.skillFx:
蓄力 1.4 s：把草叉往地上一插，蹲下抱起一块 5×4 的大卵石，一点点举过头顶（0–0.7 s 缓入）。举满后整个人发抖（左右抖 1 格），额头冒 3 滴汗（白色小点往下落），锅盔滑到眼睛上；脚下的尘土慢慢往外飘；不开轮廓光（没有魔法）。
施放 0.5 s：「嘿！」整个人往前一扑，把石头抛出去；石头走高抛物线（shoot 带 vy 和重力），脚下扬尘 10 颗；震屏 2 格，天空闪白压到最弱（0.03 s）。
命中：石头砸在假人头上，碎成 4–5 块（K_PHYS 重力，落地弹跳）+ 一大团尘云（fx.cloud dust）+ 12 颗 impact 外爆；假人闪白、下沉 1 格、头顶转星（dummyFx stun）；震屏 1 格；一次 impact。
收招 0.7 s：保持前扑的姿势晃两下、差点摔倒，然后站直，推回锅盔，拔起草叉
plans.sound: 粗布窸窣 + 锅盔「咣当咣当」；标志性的一声 = 锅盔挨打时像敲锅一样的「铛」+ 举石头时吃力的「嗯——嘿！」和石头砸地的闷「咚」；重量 0.4（SFX body flesh · how topple · pal earth · style meteor · w 0.4）

chars.summary: 持盾卫士（普通·先锋）：矮壮 stocky，赭黄墨带鸢盾（9×15，盾面斜插 3 支断箭）+ 护鼻尖顶盔 + 锁子护颈 + 赭黄菱格棉甲，后手翼片钉头锤。六个状态都有：待机个性是拔箭（从盾上拔一支断箭扔到身后，3 支变 2 支）；移动是侧身盾步；攻击是越过盾沿短促下砸；技能「偏转」是缩身斜举盾，盾前亮起 45° 青铜点阵偏转面，三支敌箭被改道（插地 / 弹飞后掉回来插在盾上 / 擦过头顶）；受击；死亡是前扑压盾。元素 bronze [21,5,33,32,19]，SFX armor·topple·metal·shield·w0.55。这一轮只改了死亡：趴下的身体改用 sw 3，不再像一只立着的箱子；平拍的盾改成盾尖在身前、盾顶在远处（和往前倒的方向一致），盾心钉露出来，能看到它闪两下再熄灭；盾拍地的扬尘和 fall 从 0.18 s 挪到 0.42 s，原来这时盾还没倒，中间「快倒平」那一档原来被跳过了，现在补上；离地 lift 原来在 begin 和 rig 里各加一次，改成只由 rig 加在身体上。shoot 退出码 0，compare 退出码 0（最近的是维京战士：待机 IoU 0.698、配色 0.792），compare --prev 退出码 0，移动 gaitEvery2 为 0,2,4,6。实际高 27 格，分配写约 23 格：分配指定的部件库 helm nasal 盔尖本身就高出头顶 4 格，design.md 里写明了。

重装战士（稀有·先锋，由持盾卫士升级来）：巨躯 giant 短腿，同一面盾放大成 11×20 塔鸢盾（顶钉、铜铆钉、5 支断箭、5×5 大铜钉）+ 护鼻尖盔加猪嘴面甲 + 盔缨 + 黑铁板甲 + 赭黄纹章罩袍 + 三片叠层肩甲，后手单手链枷。六个状态都有：待机是掀面甲透气；移动是插盾推进；攻击是链枷头顶抡一圈后甩砸假人头顶，刺球落地弹一下；技能「铜墙」是塔盾插地、铆钉逐行亮起，张开一堵半椭圆青铜墙，5 箭 + 1 弩矢撞墙后卸力坠地堆在盾前，最后推出一道贴地冲击波；受击；死亡是跪下、盾倒地、再用死亡套件 parts 散架。SFX armor·collapse·metal·shield·w0.95。这一轮改了：罩袍从瓶子形改成 7 格宽的前襟，两侧露出腿甲裙，纹章斜带挪到前襟上；猪嘴改成上亮下暗的锥形；大铜钉外圈待机时是铁箍，蓄力时亮成青铜；铜墙从一条竖线改成底在盾尖、往前鼓 3 格的半椭圆点阵墙，箭停在弧面上。shoot 退出码 0，compare 退出码 0（最近的是焚尸人：IoU 0.652；钢铁军阀配色 0.943 但待机 IoU 只有 0.622），compare --prev 退出码 0，gaitEvery2 为 0,2,4,6。实际高 35 格（含盔缨），分配写约 31 格，原因同上（nasal 盔尖加盔缨），design.md 里写明了。

built.feedback: 1) 部件库 helm 'nasal' 的盔尖固定高出头顶 4 格，没有参数能调低。分配卡按「盔尖高出头顶 2 格」估的身高，两个角色因此都高了 3–4 格。建议 helm 加一个 peak（盔尖高度）参数，或者让出分配的人按库里的实际尺寸估身高。2) parts.rig 在 lying 时已经在 R.oy 里减了 P.lift，README 的拼装例子又写 E.begin(hero, P.bx, -P.lift)，照抄的话身体会浮起 2 倍高度，掉在地上的 free 部件（盾、武器、盔）也跟着浮起。建议 README 写清楚：lift 只交给 rig，begin 不要再减。3) 倒地转 90° 以后，身体厚度等于 2×sw。stocky / fat / giant 这类 sw 5–6 的体型趴下有 11 行高，看上去像一个立着的方块。建议 rig 加一个 lieSw 选项（倒地时收薄），或者在 README 里提醒。

chars.summary: 精英猎手（优质 · 人类射手）：瘦高 slim，约 26 格高，猫腰前倾。林绿尖角兜帽后垂 3 格，锯齿下摆短斗篷，前手竖握比人还长的 29 格反曲木长弓，背后斜背绿羽箭袋，另有皮护臂和腰后猎刀。元素：刀锋 · 翠羽（nature 色阶）。攻击：满弓三箭扇形齐射，分别射向头、胸、脚边。技能「多重射击」：单膝半跪，斜弓逐支搭上三箭，三串光点汇聚；松弦后大箭在半空「叉」地一分为三，同时命中头、胸、脚边。死亡：仰倒撒箭，长弓脱手翻一圈落地，兜帽盖住眼睛。SFX 为 flesh / topple / nature / blade / 0.35。本轮是第 3 轮，改了两处：一是箭袋皮筒加长到 9 格、肩后露出 3–4 格，箭杆只露 0–2 格、以绿羽为主，原来只看到一块浅色箭杆楔形，读不出是箭袋；二是倒地洒出的箭往身体收，不再被舞台左边切掉。shoot 退出码 0，没有 audit 问题；compare 退出码 0，最近的是鹰喙弓手（0.64 / 0.421 / 0.736）；--prev 只有箭袋区域有变化；gaitEvery2 为 0,2,4,6。

暗夜射手（传说 · 由精英猎手升级）：同一个人换夜装。slim 拉长到约 32 格，站姿笔直。保留加长的墨绿尖兜帽（尖端垂到肩胛），戴银面罩、露出月白眼光；及小腿的开衩风衣，后摆飘成燕尾；腿侧矢筒插绿羽弩矢；武器是月牙重连弩（银月牙弩臂、竖箭匣、侧摇柄）。元素：迅捷 · 月华（fxRamp moonlight [21,5,60,4,3]）。攻击：预兆 1 帧后连射 4 矢，每发后坐 1 格。技能「超速射击」：摇柄越转越快，月白光点从四周吸进两只月牙尖，身后叠出 1→3 层残影；施放时本体和残影交替开火，五连发，配全屏横向速度线，第五发加冲击环和月牙斩痕。死亡：跪倒，用死亡套件 melt 融成一滩影子，银面罩「叮」地掉在地上。SFX 为 flesh / dissolve / shadow / shadow / 0.45。本轮是第 3 轮：技能的蓄力、施放、收招前半都改成扎稳步（技能专用体型 stride 3，膝微屈，弩抬高 1 格），原来和待机 / 攻击的直立端弩几乎一样；残影快照也跟着换成分腿姿，残影剪影里看得出腿。shoot 退出码 0；compare 退出码 0，最近的是巨魔（0.595 / 0.544 / 0.165）；和精英猎手对比为 0.486 / 0.372 / 0.69；--prev 只标出施放 / 收招，是有意改的；gaitEvery2 为 0,2,4,6。

built.feedback: 1）shoot.mjs 额外截图时间点只能用 SHOOT_PLAN 环境变量传，角色目录里没有地方存。验收员不带这个变量重跑，就截不到 3_attack_draw、4_skill_charge_full、8_death_stagger 这几张；默认的 3_attack_strike（0.2 s）也正好落在精英猎手满弓还没松弦的那一帧。建议让 shoot.mjs 读模块导出的 SHOOT_PLAN，或者读输出目录里的 plan.json。2）这批代理共用一个 scratchpad，我写的临时脚本 montage.mjs 被别的代理覆盖了一次，建议给每个代理分子目录。3）parts.bow 只能竖放、弯度小，parts.crossbow 没有箭匣、摇柄这类连弩结构，所以两个射手都自己画了武器，已经标成候选部件。

chars.summary: 惩戒牧师（稀有射手，standard 档约 21×29，含光环）：剃顶的年轻修士，身穿及地白亚麻长袍，胸前两条金圣带，头后是一轮带 12 根芒的日轮光环（芒同时充当法力条），前手用 5 格铜链提着金香炉，后腰贴一本红封金角经书。攻击：香炉往前甩，放出正弦形的金色粒子波，假人头顶叠日点。技能（太阳耀斑 + 粒子波叠层）：香炉抡整圈、12 根芒逐根点亮，然后日冕爆开，连甩三道 1→2→3 格粗的粒子波，日点从 1 叠到 3。死亡：跪下合十后侧身倒地，香炉滚一圈，光环裂成两半，最后消散、魂光上升。元素用 fxRamp solar，SFX 为 flesh/collapse/holy/buff/0.45，step/swing/shoot/hit/impact×3/fall 都落在对应帧上。这一轮（接着已有的一版）改了两处：光环圆心往后挪 1 格，日盘完整露出、中心淡金、环比日盘暗一级，不再像一头金色刺毛；蓄力时前手伸到身前侧，香炉转圈不再横过脸。验证：shoot 退出码 0（audit 无问题，专属色 0）；compare 退出码 0，最接近的是维京战士（待机 IoU 0.679，配色 0.461）；compare --prev 没有消失区域；移动 gaitEvery2 为 0,2,4,6，两只鞋前后互换。产出：pcd/chars/PunishingCleric.js、pcd/batch-02/PunishingCleric/design.md（附第 3 轮修改记录）、shots/。

主教（神话射手，tall 档，悬浮离地 3 格，约 28×39）：和惩戒牧师是同一个人，保留剃顶、光环（放大成双圈、24 根芒）、腰间金香炉、白金配色和日耀元素；戴白色分叉主教冠，背后两条深红冠带，披金色大斗篷（深红内衬、白色日轮刺绣），双手持日轮权杖，杖顶是带 8 根芒的日盘，身下有地面影子。攻击：权杖前指放直线净化光束，假人四周的 10 格日点环亮一格。技能（超级太阳耀斑 + 净化光束叠层）：升空到 6 格、脚下日晷法阵、24 根芒逐根点亮，然后大日冕爆开，光束连射三段（1→2→3 格宽），日点环 1→10 填满，最后收金色描边加击退。死亡：坠地、跪住，权杖倒下，主教冠滚开，再用死亡套件 ash 化成日耀光点，光环碎成金屑。收招时长从默认 0.7 s 改成 1.2 s：三段光束共 15 帧，放不进 0.5 s 的施放段，已写进设定卡。这一轮看放大帧后改了身体：斗篷原来只盖到离地 9 格，下面露出一大截白袍像幽灵尾巴，后沿还拉成一道翅膀似的斜线。现在斗篷一直垂到袍底尖上面，成上窄下宽的长梯形，前襟开口露出白袍，远侧内衬只露 1 列，刺绣改为 3 个；主教冠从两只细尖（像兔耳朵）改成 7 宽 × 7 行、顶上留 3 格缺口的分叉冠。验证：shoot 退出码 0（audit 无问题，专属色 0，悬浮单位按规定不发 step）；compare 退出码 0，最接近的是时间法师（待机 IoU 0.651）；compare --prev 消失的只有原来那道翅膀斜线，是有意改的；和惩戒牧师待机 IoU 0.417。产出：pcd/chars/Bishop.js、pcd/batch-02/Bishop/design.md（附第 3 轮修改记录）、shots/。

built.feedback: 1）frames.mjs --contact 模式会把 --scale 后面的数值当成 sprite.json 文件路径去读，直接报 ENOENT；要放大只能不加 --scale，或者自己写取帧脚本。2）工作流里所有代理共用同一个 scratchpad 目录，常用文件名（contact.png、r0/、crop.sh）会被别的代理同时覆盖；我这边一度把共享的 r0/ 挪进了自己的子目录，已经马上挪回原位。我自己的 crop.sh 写进 scratchpad 根目录时，那里原本可能已有别的代理的同名文件，如果有就被覆盖了，内容没法恢复。建议给每个制作者分一个子目录。3）部件库的 cape 只能画在身后的披风，画不了前襟开口、从肩头盖住整个身侧的祭披式斗篷，主教只好自己写 cope；建议以后收进库。4）默认的三个时长放不下「施放后连射三段、每段 4 帧」这类多段技能，只能延长收招时长，再用 SHOOT_PLAN 另截时间点核对；SKILL.md 可以写明这是允许的做法。

chars.summary: 两个角色的模块、设定卡和截图在之前两轮里就已经做完，这一轮只做确认，没有改代码。卫队长（史诗先锋，英武档，身体 28 格加冠羽 4 格，共 32 格）：开面盔上一道前后向的紫色马鬃冠羽，身前一面金包角的紫晶方盾（10 格法力刻度），及膝紫披风，后手持带紫血槽的单手长剑，腰间挂剑鞘。攻击是盾不离身的单手斜劈。待机是持剑行礼，移动是阅兵正步（lift 3），死亡是跪亡不倒：拄剑跪地，刻度逐格熄灭，然后消散。技能「神盾」：两发敌弹打在盾上各充 1 格，光点汇聚把 10 格刻度逐格点亮，盾前投出六角盾印并抽剑附魔，前冲斜劈，落点炸开小范围紫环，左右地面各亮一点。元素 aegis 为白 21 → 43 → 24 → 42 → 52。SFX 声明：armor / collapse / arcane / spiral，w 0.7。这一轮 shoot.mjs 和 compare.mjs 退出码都是 0，--prev 对第 2 轮各状态 IoU 都是 1；frames.mjs 的 gaitEvery2 前 4 个编号各不相同。同批两两比较没有撞脸，最近的是重装战士（待机 IoU 0.669）。

奥法元帅（神话战士，巨英武档，身体 31 格加冠羽 5 格，共 36 格），和卫队长是同一个人，千年之后。闭面盔上冠羽拖到后背，两侧有金翼饰，眼缝透紫光。武器是 22 格长的双手巨剑，剑身 10 个符文，剑首一颗紫晶。同一面神盾放大镶金，悬浮在身后肩旁并会自转。披风是及地破边长披风。攻击是从后下方扫到前上方的双手大半圆扫。待机是拄剑而立，神盾浮动自转。移动是阔步（stride 5），每步留 1 格紫色脚印余光，神盾晚一拍跟着飘。死亡是符文崩散：神盾先坠地，然后全身用 burst 炸成紫色碎块，只剩巨剑插在原地，符文逐个熄灭。技能「最终审判」：展开审判法阵，符文逐个点亮，神盾归位成头后的光环；头顶化出两倍大的光剑虚影，一记大横扫，落点炸开中范围冲击波（紫浪、地裂、36 颗外爆），共两次 impact。SFX 声明：armor / explode / arcane / nova，w 1.0。这一轮 shoot.mjs 和 compare.mjs 退出码都是 0（最近的是钢铁军阀，待机 IoU 0.597），--prev 各状态 IoU 都是 1；gaitEvery2 前 4 帧各不相同。

built.feedback: 两个角色的模块、设定卡和截图在我开始前就已经做完了（之前两轮）。这一轮我只重跑了 shoot、compare、compare --prev、frames 和同批两两比较，没有改代码。compare.mjs 默认只和 accepted 比，同批还没通过的角色要另外用 --all 手动比，建议在说明里写一句。frames.mjs 在移动状态报 distinct 20（12 fps 下没有一帧完全重复），原因可能是有部件按 12 fps 飘动，这样没法直接判断「每个步态帧各 2 帧」，只能看 gaitEvery2。

chars.summary: 民兵（圆胖小个 fat，身体到锅顶 24 行，叉齿到 −28）。剪影靠三样东西：倒扣的烟黑铁锅盔，锅柄向后横伸 4 格；比人高的三齿草叉，一齿是弯的；围裙兜住的圆肚子。另有卷裤腿、草鞋、腰后木勺和布袋、红脸蛋。全身土褐粗布 wood + 奶白袖 bone + 灰围裙 stone，没有金属甲，也没有发光体。攻击：双手握叉笨拙前捅，先往后缩并闭眼，前冲 2 格后差点栽倒。技能是守城投石：把叉插在身后，抱起 5×4 冷灰卵石举过头顶，举着发抖、冒汗、锅盔滑下来；然后「嘿！」一扑，石头走抛物线（模块自己算重力）砸在假人头上，碎成 5 块落地弹跳，加两团尘云、impact 火花和眩晕星。死亡：后退、坐倒、仰躺，锅盔飞出去扣在地上「铛铛铛」转三圈。音色 SFX body flesh · topple · earth · meteor · w 0.4。本轮是在已有模块上返修一轮：石头改成冷灰（原来和奶白袖同色），画在前袖之后、前手压在上面（原来抱在胸前那几帧整块被袖子盖住）；围裙下摆收高 1 行，露出卷起的裤脚；命中时多加一团尘云。检查结果：shoot 退出码 0，audit 无问题，色板外颜色 0；compare 退出码 0，最近的是星辉巫师，待机 IoU 0.63，配色 0.35；compare --prev 只少了围裙下摆前角 2 格，是有意改的；移动 20 帧全不同，gaitEvery2 前 4 个编号各不相同。

partsAdded: pot 铁锅盔（倒扣铁锅：烟黑锅底、外翻锅沿、后伸锅柄可晃；可滑下盖眼 / 被打得上跳；并进脸的部件；掉地后 at+rot 翻滚、spin 地上转圈 4 朝向）
forkTines 草叉齿（在 HEADS.trident 上加长三齿，其中一齿外弯，跟叉头按 90° 转）
boulder 5×4 大卵石（一个部件，裂纹 + 左上高光；抱在手里 / 放在地上）
legs 'rolled' 卷裤腿 + 草鞋（裤 → 卷起的裤脚亮行 → 赤脚踝 → 草鞋 + 绑带 + 脚趾；同 rig 步态，trem 膝盖抖）
legs 坐姿 sitLegs（一屁股坐地、两腿前伸、脚尖朝上，精灵本地坐标）
spoon 腰间木勺（挂在腰绳上、勺头朝下、伸出背后 1 格）
built.feedback: 1) 分配写的是「shoot 带 vy 和重力」，但引擎的 shoot 里 vy 是常量，没有重力，所以高抛物线的石头只能在模块里自己记位置和速度（stepFX 推进、fxFront 画）。2) 分配要碎石「K_PHYS 重力，落地弹跳」，但 K_PHYS 的 floor 是落地就贴住、没有弹跳，只好在模块里自己养 5 个碎块的小数组，和 README「别在模块里自己养粒子池」冲突；建议 spawnX 加一个 bounce 选项。3) 分配写「每秒 8 帧的快碎步」，但 gaitEvery2 验收要求按 6 fps 取 4 个不同的步态帧，8 fps 过不了；最后脚按 6 fps 走，「快」放到 12 fps 的身体颠动里。4) fx.cloud 只画色阶的后三级，dust 的 10 / 9 / 8 在夜空里看不见，只好自建 dustLight 色阶。5) parts.legs 的 'sandal' 没有卷裤腿的选项，另写了候选部件。6) 6 行高的头上戴铁锅盔，锅单独成部件时整行脸会被压成勾线色，只好把锅并进脸的部件（README 的小头规则只讲了盔 + 须 + 发三样，没讲并进脸的写法）。7) 色板下标 8 同时是 bone 的勾线和 stone 的暗色，奶白袖和灰围裙贴在一起时分界不太清楚。8) parts.arm 画袖子和手是同一次调用，抱在胸前的道具要夹在前袖和前手之间时，得先用 grip:'none' 画袖子、再画道具、最后单独补 parts.hand。这个做法 README 里有写，但没有「抱物」的例子。

built.feedback: 1) This was a rebuild with the same lanes as last time. The modules, design.md files and shots/ from the earlier run were still in place, and accepted/EagleBeakedArcher and accepted/CatapultArcher already hold those characters' previous versions. Running compare.mjs against ROOT/accepted unchanged compares each character with its own old copy and flags it as a duplicate. compare.mjs never skips a file with the same name, so I left each character's own directory out of accepted/ by hand. The reviewer or the workflow should do the same, or clear those entries before a rebuild. 2) The fix pass on AngelArcher after review 1 had changed the code (13:17), but it never re-ran shoot, never added the '第 1 轮修改记录' to design.md, and there was no review-2. The reason for the round-1 rejection was not in any file. I ran every check again on the current state and put the --prev results in design.md. 3) The zsh in this environment does not split an unquoted $var into words, so passing a directory list with $dirs in a loop quietly compares only 2 characters and still exits 0. Use ${=dirs} or an array. 4) Candidate parts already marked in the modules for adding to the library later: beakSkull, recurve, stonebow, angelWing, longbow, drawArm (arm with an explicit elbow, because parts.arm's two-segment IK cannot bend the elbow behind the body). parts.js and parts-beast.js were not touched.

built.feedback: 1) The scratchpad directory is shared by all parallel sub-agents. My first helper script, $S/run.sh, collided with another agent's file of the same name: it was overwritten, and I may have overwritten theirs first. Later I accidentally ran their version and it wrote a nested scratchpad/private/... directory (deleted afterwards). Suggest the workflow give each agent its own subdirectory, or tell agents to use a private subfolder. 2) frames.mjs --contact does not accept --scale: the scale value gets read as a sprite.json path and it errors out. 3) A material's outline index is also used as the selective outline, so a flat glow material with a bright outline index (e.g. [22,22,22,21] or [5,5,21,21]) wraps its pixels in a ring of bright color. Easy to miss; worth one line in README 'Colors' saying flat glow materials should use a dark outline index. 4) The fx.bolt primitive has fixed ±4 jitter and no width setting. For short distances (cloud to crest, about 12 cells) it zigzags across the body, and it can't make chain lightning that thins segment by segment, so I kept a module-local chainBolt. A width/amplitude option would help. 5) This task restarted existing modules and a review-1 folder with no review notes attached. I treated it as a rework round and ran --prev; stating in the task whether it is a fresh build or a rework would remove the guesswork.

built.feedback: 1) compare.mjs compares a character against every folder under accepted/, including the character's own accepted copy. On a re-run, SteelWarlord would match its own accepted/SteelWarlord and exit with 2 (duplicate). I had to leave out accepted/<self> by hand. The script should skip entries with the same key or name. 2) In frames.mjs --contact, the value after --scale is not removed from the file list, so `--contact out.png a.json b.json --scale 5` tries to read "5" as a file and fails. 3) The module-writing example in README does not list FLOOR in the destructuring. A module had used FLOOR bare as a global, and during the second half of the charge it threw a ReferenceError that made shoot exit with 2. Please add FLOOR to the example's destructuring list, or note in the README that anything from the engine must be taken from E. 4) Under zsh, an unquoted $dirs is not split into words, so when a batch compare reads the accepted/ list from a variable it silently compares against the reference only. Worth a line in the README (use bash or ${=dirs}).

built.feedback: 1) __pc.at(state, 0) runs no update, so render reuses the previous state's pose: at('idle', 0) showed the pose from 1.4 s. Frame 0 checks need t ≥ 1/60, or at() should call poseAt once itself. 2) compare.mjs recurses into accepted/ with no key filter. When a character is rebuilt, its own earlier copy in accepted/ (for example accepted/RedDragon) always gets flagged at IoU ≈ 0.98. Reviewers need to skip the same key, or the script should filter by the name / key field. 3) The bake adds a dark edge to every erased pixel that touches material, so a hole smaller than 3×3 in a membrane comes out as a solid dark dot. This should be in the README. 4) B.wing fixes the trailing-edge anchor at (x − chord, y + 1). For downstroke poses (a0 ≤ 0) the membrane collapses into a line. I worked around it with a per-pose trailing-edge drop parameter; adding it to B.wing's pose table would be worth doing. 5) The far wing drawn with full finger bones at a 2–3 cell offset piles up edge lines against the near wing (the main cause of both dragons looking like a tangle of bones). The parts-beast.md dragon section could suggest drawing the far wing as membrane plus arm only, or not at all in spread poses.

suggestions: ATTACK frame 1 (wind-up): when the staff pulls back, the crescent head lands on the halo and the two merge into an X-shaped lump in the silhouette. Reduce the pull-back angle so the staff head stops at least 2 cells to the lower right of the halo.
HURT: the character is a zombie, so per standard §6 (undead) add 4–6 bone-ash dust sparks on top of the impact sparks.

At game scale the 5 moon-phase plaques on the chest (2×2 each) read as one column of white blocks. Enlarge the last plaque (full moon) to 3×3 as the end piece, or put a 1-cell dark lining behind the chain, so the new-moon to full-moon progression is readable.
review.note: shoot exit 0 (audit clean, 4 own colours, SFX timeline correct: step on contact frames 0/4/8/12/16, swing+shoot on attack frame 2, hit when the blade arrives at frame 4, impact on cast frame 3, fall at kneel landing frame 8). compare exit 0; closest is SteelWarlord (idle IoU 0.553, colour 0.69). Silhouette reads as a hunched mage: floating crescent crown + crescent staff + floor-length robe with trailing rags. Stitched mouth, purple eyes and moon plaques are all present. Idle personality (look up at the moon, touch the plaques, crown flash), robe-wave glide, one-handed thrust with crescent-blade projectile, and skill (moon grows new to full, plaques light, sky dims -> beam -> inward pull then crescent slash + big ring) all match the assignment. Death: kneel, staff slides away, melt into a puddle, crown drops onto it and goes out. Passed; copied to accepted/MoonlightApostle.

suggestions: ATTACK strike frame (frame 2) is almost the same silhouette as MoonlightApostle's one-handed thrust: staff horizontal pointing at the target, head piece forming a bowl. Change it to the assigned 'two-handed horizontal raise overhead': hands about 6 cells apart on the shaft, staff 2–3 cells above the head, hourglass kept upright. Then on frame 3 press the staff forward and down to lob the star-sand shot. This keeps the upgrade line's attacks visually distinct.
The 2 meteor shards in idle frames are dark stone against the cape and hard to see. Raise the crack brightness one level, or add a 1-cell pale-purple rim on the outer edge.

In the 0.9 s skill-charge screenshot the moonglow dotted links (fx.link) to the allies are almost invisible. Extend them to the ally's head and raise brightness to level 2 of the ramp so the mana-aura trait is readable.
DEATH: sand dissolution starts only about 0.16 s after the hourglass shatters. Push the start to about 0.8 s so there is a short still beat (standard §7).
review.note: shoot exit 0 (audit clean, hover so no step events; swing+shoot on frame 2, hit on sand-shot landing frame 6, impact on meteor landing cast frame 3, fall on frame 7). compare exit 2 only because accepted/TimeMage is this character's own previous snapshot (IoU 0.944; compare --prev shows no regression, only enlarged shards). Death turns to sand and piles up; ring shatters into moon phases. Passed; copied to accepted/TimeMage (overwrites the old snapshot).

suggestions: IDLE/MOVE: the torn wing's lead finger (bone 6) and the long far horn make two long parallel pale diagonals. In the contact sheet this reads as two spears stuck in the back, not a folded torn wing. Darken the middle of the lead finger to 7, keep 6 only on the 2-cell bone tip, widen the crimson membrane between the fingers, and enlarge the 3 holes from 2×2 to 3×2 so sky shows through (a 2-cell gap fills in under the outline).
The eye uses orange 46, the same colour as the lava cracks, so the face does not read. Change the eye to gold 47 plus a 1-cell 21 highlight, with a 1-cell ink socket below it.

Crack pixels are too many and too scattered (lone 46/47 pixels everywhere), which drowns the upper-left lit 57 surface. Merge the cracks into continuous 1-cell zigzag lines and remove isolated single pixels, so the body shows lit and dark areas as blocks.

SKILL charge: the crouch is so flat that head and limbs sink into the torso and the silhouette becomes a puddle. Keep the front legs visibly braced forward by 2 cells and keep the head 1–2 cells clear of the chest line.
review.note: shoot exit 0 (audit clean, 1 own colour; step on contact frames, swing on frame 2, hit on bite-close frame 3, three impacts on cast frames 2/4 + recover frame 1, fall at frame 11 when it hits the ground, hammer landing hit at frame 17). compare exit 2 only because accepted/RedDragon is its own previous snapshot (IoU 0.976; compare --prev shows changes only on the wing). Death (side topple, legs up, hammer rolls away, cools to stone, dissolves) is excellent. Weak points are the wing reading as bone sticks, speckled crack texture and an unreadable eye, all scored 3. Passed; copied to accepted/RedDragon (overwrites the old snapshot).

review.note: shoot exit 0 (audit clean, 1 own colour; hover so no step; swing+hit on tail-strike frame 2, three refraction impacts on cast frames 1/3/5, fall on flat-landing frame 11). compare exit 0; closest is RedDragon 0.322/0.221/0.297. built.feedback: 1) compare.mjs does not skip a character's own entry. Troll already has an accepted copy in accepted/Troll, so rebuilding it always flags itself (IoU 1.0, exit 2). Suggest skipping entries with the same name/key, or passing an exclude argument. 2) With hunch set, parts.edges puts the shoulder at the front top of the torso and bulges the back lower down. That gives no 'back hump higher than the head' silhouette, so the hump had to be added by hand as extra rows. Suggest a hump / humpY field on the rig. 3) The 'glow extinguished' tone is easy to get wrong: several modules write `gem >= 2 ? bright : gem === 4 ? dark`, and the dead state ends up brightest. Suggest the engine expose a shared glowTone(P.gem) helper. 4) frames.mjs --contact and the exported frames do not apply flip, so a mirrored skill charge frame appears unmirrored in the contact sheet. Not a bug, but easy to misjudge; worth a note in the docs. 5) Many agents work in the scratchpad at once, and a shared bak/ directory with generic file names like design.md can overwrite each other. Suggest each run use its own subdirectory.

built.feedback: 1）accepted/RedWorm 是上一轮验收存下的赤蠕虫本身。重跑同一角色时，按原命令查重会拿它和自己比，IoU 1.0，退出码 2。建议 compare.mjs 跳过同 key 的条目，或者重跑前先清掉。我是临时建了一个去掉 RedWorm 的 accepted 目录再比的。2）serpent 部件缺三样。一是直立的粗胸节（颈是 S 形贝塞尔，竖起段会斜成一团）。二是能长出背线的倒刺（serpent.spikes 只画 1 格小点，而且拿不到背线位置）。三是 worm 头太小，读不出圆口。这三样都只能在模块里自己写，建议收进库：serpentThorax、serpentSpikes、wormMaw。3）frames.mjs 在帧多的状态上缩得很小。我是先挑几帧另存成一个 sprite.json，再用 --scale 放大看的。建议支持直接指定「状态:帧号」的参数。

built.feedback: 1) 部件库 B.wing 的收拢 / 半收翼姿（0、4）在翼展 16–21 这种人形背翼上，只剩一根棒子或一个布袋，读不出是翅膀；翼姿又只能用 B.WINGS 下标，传不进自定义角度，所以写了候选部件 batWing（每个翼姿直接给坐标）。建议 B.wing 支持传入自定义翼姿 {w, tips, b}，并走 rig 变换。2) E.keyer 会忽略第 4 个元素（倍数），而 README 的 keyer 例子（['a',-32,32,1/ASTEP]）是按 parts.keyer 写的。直接把 dq（0–1）编进 E.keyer 只有 0/1 两档，查看页里死亡消散会一下子整个消失；导出时逐帧重画，所以 sprite.json 和截图都看不出来。建议 E.keyer 支持倍数，或在 README 里写明要编 dq48。3) rimAll 加上 10 格以上的半径，会把瘦小角色的整圈外沿刷成元素浅色，读成冰冻的鬼影；README 可以提醒小体型用按方向打的轮廓光，把光源放在身体外面。4) frames.mjs 的 --contact 模式里，--scale 后面的数值会被当成 sprite.json 文件名读取，直接报 ENOENT。

built.feedback: 1) The standard compare command (compare.mjs <sprite-lite> reference pcd/accepted) also checks a character against its own accepted copy. SnakeGodMessenger is already in pcd/accepted, so that pairing gives IoU 1.0 and exit 2 purely because it is comparing itself. I passed every accepted directory except its own. Suggest compare.mjs skip entries with the same name/key, or the workflow exclude pcd/accepted/<key> automatically. 2) This build step was a re-run: both modules and design.md already existed from an earlier run with the identical assignment. DesertBeliever.js was left half-edited by an interrupted fix: P.sb was used by the staff geometry but never set by a pose or added to the cache key. The prompt does not say whether to rebuild from scratch or continue, so I continued from the existing files. Suggest the build prompt say "existing files: continue / overwrite" explicitly. 3) The scratchpad is shared between parallel agents (r0/, base/ and similar directories hold other characters' output). chars.summary: 魔盾兵：一个矮壮的兽人重甲兵（stocky，覆盖 sw6 / limb1.35 / lw4 / headX −2），待机外框 26×27。没有武器，只有一面 11×17 的暗青铜符文塔盾：上沿两角是獠牙护角，盾面 3 列竖排符文，中间一列往下错 1 行。其余部件：锯齿鳍冠盔（盔缝里一对琥珀小眼，口缝一根外翻獠牙，下面露出墨绿下巴，两颊是獠牙形护颊）、三层叠片铁肩甲、腰间一串符文石片。攻击：双脚不挪，塔盾往前一顶 3 格，盾面前鼓出一道冲击波。技能「魔盾」：盾底插进地里，符文从下往上逐行点亮，地面的紫色粒子汇聚到盾心；施放时身前立起一面 3×24 的蜂巢点阵符文护壁，两颗敌弹撞上去被吸住，碎成紫色火花。死亡：符文逐格熄灭，盾碎成青铜碎片和紫色符文碎片，手里只剩半截盾，往后坐倒（离地 3→1→0），头盔歪到一边，然后消散，魂光上升。本轮在上一版的基础上复查并修改了三处：①待机和攻击时盾的左獠牙护角正好盖住眼缝，脸看不出来。改法是把头往后缩 2 格，所有姿势的盾往前 3 格（站位 77→74，护壁 WALL_LX 13→16，屏幕位置不变），现在眼、獠牙、下巴都露在头和盾之间，剪影里头和盾分成两块；②盾面符文排得太整齐像窗格，中间一列往下错了 1 行；③坐倒的 fall 音效比落地帧早 1 帧，T_LAND 0.58→0.62。自检结果：shoot 退出码 0，audit 没有问题；compare 退出码 0，最接近的是焚尸人（待机 IoU 0.692，配色 0.012）；compare --prev 列出的消失区域都是这次有意移动的；移动 gaitEvery2 前 4 个各不相同；音效 step 落在步态接触帧，swing / hit 在攻击第 2 帧，fall 在离地 0 的第 11 帧。文件：/Users/yseer/Code/midnight-cabinet/pcd/chars/MagicShieldSoldier.js、/Users/yseer/Code/midnight-cabinet/pcd/batch-04/MagicShieldSoldier/design.md（末尾补了第 3 轮记录）、/Users/yseer/Code/midnight-cabinet/pcd/batch-04/MagicShieldSoldier/shots

破魔守卫：魔盾兵升级后的同一个兽人（heroic，覆盖 sw6 / limb1.45 / lw4 / neck1），待机外框 33×37，秘银白甲加金镶边。魔盾兵的特征都保留并升级：塔盾变成 13×22 的金框秘银破魔塔盾，加了翼形护边和包金獠牙护角，盾心一只立体的「破魔之眼」（瞳孔左右扫视，眼睑分睁 / 半闭 / 闭三档）；鳍冠加高到 6 格；头后浮着 6 块转动的符文石板；叠片肩甲变成三层带尖刺的巨肩甲，各套一个转动的符文环；另加胸口紫色符文核心、腰下锁甲裙，面甲缝里是空的，只透出两点紫光。攻击：塔盾往前顶 4 格再往上一掀，下沿撩出一道银白拖影。技能「破魔」：盾心之眼睁开，紫色粒子逆时针螺旋吸进眼里，一颗敌方魔法弹被吸住、绕眼转半圈；施放时一眨眼把它吞掉（变灰、碎掉），同时放出银白十字星芒、贴地推开的破魔环（ring + 前后两道 fx.wave，steel 色阶）；假人被描一圈银白边并去色，头上一点紫光被抽回盾心。待机时面甲缝喷一口紫雾；走路是重步，落脚处留一格紫色余光。死亡：眼睛闭上，石板一块块掉落，death.start('parts') 让盔甲散架，塔盾原地立着，原地一团紫光闪三下后熄灭，然后消散，魂光上升。这一轮复查后模块没改：魔盾兵改成头缩后、盾举在身前的站法以后，两级的持盾姿势已经一致；只重跑了验证，更新了设定卡里的查重数据和第 3 轮记录。自检结果：shoot 退出码 0；compare 退出码 0，最接近的是焚尸人（0.659 / 0.074）；钢铁军阀配色相似度 0.721，没到阈值；和改过的魔盾兵对比 IoU 0.65、配色 0.15。移动 gaitEvery2 前 4 个各不相同；音效 swing / hit 在推的那一帧，第二下 hit 在掀的那一帧，fall 在碎甲落地那一帧。文件：/Users/yseer/Code/midnight-cabinet/pcd/chars/AntiMagicGuardian.js、/Users/yseer/Code/midnight-cabinet/pcd/batch-04/AntiMagicGuardian/design.md、/Users/yseer/Code/midnight-cabinet/pcd/batch-04/AntiMagicGuardian/shots

built.feedback:
1）这两个角色上一版的文件还在原位，但同一会话里上一次工作流的第 1 轮验收员中途断了，没有返回结论，所以这一轮按「新做」处理：以现有模块为底，照 standard.md 第 10 节自己复查后再改。
2）frames.mjs --contact 不能放大：参数写成 --contact 输出.png --scale 7 a.json 时，数值「7」会被当成 sprite.json 读，直接报错。原因是文件列表只过滤掉以 -- 开头的参数，没有跳过选项后面的值。
3）持盾角色的通用坑：盾的外框、獠牙护角只要碰到脸，分界线规则就会把眼睛刷成勾线色。rig 的 headX 配合盾往前挪可以解决，建议在 README 的持盾部分提一句「盾左沿和盔面之间至少留 2 格」。
4）上一版制作者提过的几点仍然成立：短腿体型的 plate 下摆要手动收；部件库没有坐姿；蓄力阶段的动作音（比如盾插地）没有专门事件，只能借用 impact；死亡套件 parts 里的大碎片不会翻倒。

chars.summary: 巨型野猪（史诗先锋，四足楔形巨兽，待机 36×27）。在上一版基础上重画了外形：背鬃改成画在躯干之前的锯齿三角鬃（霜白尖），剪影成锯齿；皮甲缩到肩背，上面缝两块铁片，带肚带；面甲缩成护额板，额前往前上方伸出一根独角刺，和上弯的白獠牙错开 5 格；伤疤改成粉白斜线（原来的白点会被看成眼睛）；侧躺时皮甲只露贴地的一条。攻击是獠牙上挑，前冲 5 格，带向上的赭土弧。技能「奔踏」：刨地竖鬃蓄力，起跳时震屏 2 格加闪白，抛物线横移 16 格、最高离地 10 格；1.65 s 四蹄砸地，接双向地裂、从身体两头往外推的地浪、大冲击环和 30 颗土块。死亡是犁地滑倒，翻身肚子朝上伸腿，面甲掉在一旁。shoot 退出码 0（专属色 5 个，音效事件齐全）；compare 退出码 0，最接近宝石蜥蜴（待机 IoU 0.712），其次黄鬃马（配色 0.857）；gaitEvery2 为 0,2,4,6,…；对 review-1 跑 --prev 只报了背线一带的变化，都是有意改的。产出：chars/BigWildBoar.js、batch-04/BigWildBoar/design.md、batch-04/BigWildBoar/shots。

赤瞳（神话先锋，由巨型野猪升级，待机 41×29）。保留同一只的特征：楔形身体、臀上同样的两道疤、耳朵同一处缺口、带刺面甲、上弯獠牙。火焰长鬃重画成压在背线和甲上沿的火舌（间距 4，尖端往后卷，肩峰上最高），从尾根一直排到头后。铁片重甲只盖肩胸、垂到腹线，两道固定高度的横缝加铆钉，后半身露出炭黑皮。另有圆胸护带尖钉、双刺面甲、两对獠牙。赤瞳改成模块自己画的 4 档（平时、亮、暴亮白芯、熄灭），不再用库里的 glow，因为它会连口腔一起点亮；攻击和待机不再开轮廓光。攻击是上挑接前蹄踏。技能：赤瞳汇聚并拖出光痕，刨地 4 次、地裂从 2 格长到 6 格；高跃 18 格，身后 3 个暗红残影；1.65 s 第一段砸地（地裂、大冲击环、36 颗土块），1.82 s 第二段前蹄一踏（双向地浪加土刺）。死亡是踉跄、跪下、侧倒（lieLegs 0，腿贴地），面甲翻滚滚开，红眼闪三下熄灭，鬃毛从红褪成灰。shoot 退出码 0（专属色 3 个）；compare 退出码 0，最接近黄鬃马（待机 IoU 0.667，配色 0.354）；gaitEvery2 为 0,2,4,6,…；--prev 报的是背线、收招首帧、复活首帧，都是有意改的。产出：chars/RedEyes.js、batch-04/RedEyes/design.md、batch-04/RedEyes/shots。

built.feedback: 1）四足的背鬃画在躯干之前时，会被 blanket 的上沿（身体上沿减 thick）再盖掉 1 格，而且库里的 quadRidge 不知道有披挂。建议 parts-beast.md 写明：有披挂的角色要么把鬃画在披挂之后，要么鬃要加长 1 格。2）quad.head 在 P.glow ≥ 1 时会把张开的嘴也画成 m.glow。只想让眼睛发光的角色（赤瞳）只能不用 glow、自己画眼，建议把眼光和口光拆成两个字段。3）Q.blanket 的下摆按背线加固定 drop 画，不看腹线；想做「长到腹线」的马衣时，肩峰处下摆会跟着背线抬高，前后下摆也会垂到腹线以下。建议加一个 hemTo: 'belly' 选项。4）lieLegs 1（肚子朝上伸腿）时背和披挂都在下面，库里的 blanket 和 ridge 仍然画在上沿，每个角色都得自己处理侧躺时的披挂。5）动手前没有上一轮的验收意见：review-1 目录只有截图，这次按首次制作的提示词重做，只能自己对照标准返修，建议返修提示词把上轮验收意见一起带上。

suggestions: 待机个性「抠伤疤」偏轻：1.6–2.0 s 那 4 帧里只看得出低头和上臂一格红点变亮，远侧手的骨爪没有明显落到近侧上臂的疤上。可以在第 21–22 帧把远侧手抬到近侧上臂前面，用 1 格骨白爪尖压在疤上，第 23 帧掉下 1 格痂。
头身比约 5.4（头 5 格），分配写的是 6.5。可以接受；要更瘦高的话，把头压到 4 格高、下颌再前突 1 格。
技能命中的苔绿十字光点在 9 倍截图里偏小、偏暗。可以让 2–3 个十字的中心在前 0.1 s 用第 1–2 级（21 / 17）。
review.note: shoot 退出码 0（audit 无问题，音效时间线正常：step 在第 0/4/8/12/16 帧，swing+hit 在攻击第 2 帧，fall 在死亡第 11 帧落地）。compare 退出码 2，但唯一被判重的是 accepted/Troll 里上一轮通过的自己（sprite-lite 逐字节相同）。去掉自身再比退出码 0，最接近的是投石弓手（待机 IoU 0.629 / 施放 0.461 / 配色 0.464）。和上一轮 review-1 做 --prev 比较，各状态 IoU 都是 1，没有回退。剪影：前臂骨板、后掠耳、背刺三处伸出轮廓；步态换腿、长臂反摆清楚；攻击时骨爪从盾下斜抓，三指可见；死亡时骨板先撑地，再面朝下扑倒（画了单独的躺姿），背刺逐根缩回。已复制到 accepted/Troll。

suggestions: 骨刺领现在朝身后左上方扇形散开，待机时有点像身后张开一只五指骨手。设定是「围在后脑、像王座靠背」：可以让最高的两根更竖直、根部贴着后脑，整圈往头顶收拢。
受击只击退 1 格，长耳和骨刺领都没有反向甩。标准要求击退 2 格、惯性部件反甩：可以保留 1 格（重型），但在闪白后那一帧让长耳和最高两根骨刺向前甩 1 格。
攻击预兆（第 1 帧）远侧手没有搭到盾上，设定写的是「双手压盾」。可以在第 1–2 帧把远侧大手画在盾上沿。
review.note: shoot 退出码 0，audit 无问题，音效正常（step 在接触帧，swing smash + hit stone 在攻击第 2 帧，fall 在第 11 帧，盾拍胸口的 hit 在第 14 帧）。compare 退出码 0，最接近指挥官（0.671 / 0.659，配色 0.044）和钢铁军阀 0.66。--prev 变化都是 design.md 写明的有意重做。剪影读得出：倒三角巨人、骨塔盾加盾心兽头骨、骨刺领、骨冠。待机抬下巴后盾底顿地；技能里骨缝逐条亮、砸地、点阵护罩、敌弹被弹开，靠友军那一侧有裂口，完整对应「统治」；死亡直挺挺后倒，盾翻到胸口，骨冠滚到脑后，躺姿是单独画的。和巨魔、黄魔三件识别特征一致。已复制到 accepted/GreenDemon。

suggestions: 死亡：旗杆落地的尘土（16 颗）在第 14 帧生成，这时旗杆还斜在离地约 27° 的空中，第 15 帧（t=1.25 s）旗杆才贴地；跪地尘土 T_KNEE（0.64 s）落在第 7 帧，这时还是踉跄姿，第 8 帧才跪下。建议把 T_POLE 改成 INCOMING + 0.95（=15/12），T_KNEE 改成 INCOMING + 0.367（=8/12），让尘土、震屏和 fall 音效和贴地帧对齐。身体本身在第 14 帧趴下，所以 fall 放在第 14 帧目前也说得过去，不算阻断。
攻击：两次刺之间的收回帧（第 3–4 帧，bx 2、K_HOLD/K_WIND 混 0.45）和刺出帧（bx 3 / 4）只差 1–2 格，剪影里连刺两下不明显。建议收回帧改为 bx 0、完全回到 K_WIND（枪往后收 3 格），这样两次前刺各自清楚。
直刺姿（攻击第 2、5 帧，施放第 3–5 帧）：破旗挂在枪头下面，压在骨臂盾和手上，枪的前端在假人跟前糊成一团。建议端平时把旗往枪杆中段挪 3–4 格，或者平杆时旗宽从 6 减到 4，让骨尖枪头单独露出来。
头部：头和躯干、近侧手臂都是硫黄赭皮，游戏里的缩放下脸和肩膀混在一起。建议在下巴 / 后颈和肩之间留 1 行暗色（tone 2），或者把眉骨高光加宽 1 格，让往前探的脑袋一眼能看出来。
